title.narrative: Rural Development: Sustainable Development Project for Communities in Semi-arid Areas

description.narrative: The Project's objective is that poor rural and indigenous families of the Mixteca region and the Mazahua zone increase their income and employment, while strengthening their social fabric and rural economies through their organisation for rural business development.The Project represents an investment initiative aiming at the development and consolidation of pro-poor small-producer value chains, based on the strengthening of the social fabric of rural/indigenous communities; the development of their economic organisations; the promotion of sustainable agricultural production; and the rehabilitation of natural resources.The project proposal encompasses four major thrusts: (i) promoting the formation and strengthening of base economic organisations; (ii) developing human capacities for social and entrepreneurial management among a new cadre of local leaders, and rural and indigenous women and young people; (iii) supporting sustainable agricultural production through the rehabilitation and sound management of natural resources, and access of water for irrigation, human consumption and animal/agro-industrial use; and (iv) developing entrepreneurial linkages and rural microenterprises while facilitating wider access to markets.
